quote.text: There's thunder even on the loftiest peaks.
quote.author: Seneca
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • Recognize that even when the overall journey appears smooth, unexpected challenges (the "thunder") can arise, reminding us to remain ever-vigilant and nurturing.
    • Embrace these disruptions as opportunities to teach resilience and adaptability, fortifying the character of both parent and child.
  • Leadership
    • Understand that no leader, regardless of their stature, is immune to setbacks or unforeseen challenges; even the highest summits can be struck by the storm of adversity.
    • Let these moments inspire humility and continuous learning, encouraging you to build structures and cultures that withstand the inevitable tempests of change.
  • Product Management
    • Realize that every product, no matter how well-conceived or successful, can experience disruptive shifts—market changes or user needs that hit like thunder.
    • Use these moments as catalysts for innovation, ensuring that your strategies remain agile and responsive amid the unexpected challenges of the market.
